question: By what means does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker has come to know something.
That knowledge comes by the grace of the addressee.
What is known is the determination of the Kaula.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula.
uncertainties: Prior state of ignorance not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula.
